name: Obelisks
overview: Scripture clearly forbids the making and worship of obelisks or any carved images, emphasizing that God hates such idols and the practices associated with them. The commands given to Israel include not setting up standing images or pillars for worship, breaking down altars, and utterly destroying any graven images or pillars representing false gods. These instructions underscore the call to exclusive devotion to the LORD, rejecting all forms of idolatry symbolized by stone images or pillars.
